answer: Deposits are visible in oasis, and pearl reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 45 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ledge account. A bond of 38% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 2937 identities would post 1414 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
